items.quote: Earlier this month, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security’s Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP) issued advisories regarding Curricular Practical Training (CPT) for F-1 students (message on August 12, and another message on August 24). The guidance limits the circumstances under which CPT may be authorized and affects current and future CPT eligibility for some Columbia international students.
Federal immigration policy and guidance can change, and the University is closely monitoring for additional information or clarification from the federal government.
